original.target_description: Study 4: London community sample, difficult-to-read font versus easy-to-read control; two independent-samples t-tests on GCBS and belief in 7/7 conspiracy theories. This is not a scrambled-sentence task.

n.quote: The participants of Study 4 were 66 women and 74 men
n.sample_role: participants in both main between-condition outcome tests; target outcome not uniquely specified
n.exclusions: No main-study exclusions reported in §5.1; Control n = 66 and Disfluent n = 74. Total N = 140 also printed in abstract; both tests t(138).

replication.target_description: Replication Study 2: UK Prolific sample, difficult-to-read font versus easy-to-read control; two independent-samples t-tests on GCBS and belief in 7/7 conspiracy theories. This is not a scrambled-sentence task.

n.quote: After removing responses that did not pass quality checks (n = 19), 488 participants were left in the final sample.
n.sample_role: participants in both main between-condition outcome tests; target outcome not uniquely specified
n.exclusions: 507 completed; 19 failed quality checks. Missing data, failed attention checks, likely bots/fraudulent responses excluded; no speeders or 3*MAD outliers.

reported_success.quote: Overall, similarly to Replication Study 1, the original study failed to replicate.

notes: Both supplied records 1985 and 1986 have identical locators and descriptions. The study numbers and pages locate font-disfluency experiments, whereas the supplied neutral description names a scrambled-sentence manipulation; target_match is therefore false on both sides. The locators do not distinguish GCBS from the London 7/7 outcome. No outcome assignment was inferred from input order; es and p are null because a unique target test cannot be established. Both candidate tests are documented below, without merging them. Original, p. 581 (PDF p. 10), §5.2: GCBS: "t(138) = 2.49, p = .014, d = 0.42." London 7/7: "t(138) = 2.01, p = .046, d = 0.34." Replication, p. 6 (PDF p. 7), §5.2: GCBS: "t(486) = 0.63, p = .529, d = 0.06"; London 7/7: "t(486) = 1.27, p = .206, d = 0.11". Candidate quotations are from the absolute source_path supplied for the corresponding side. Both full-text titles verified against assigned references. A general web search incidentally surfaced forbidden-site snippets; those were not opened or used as extraction evidence.
